resale_co.name: Resale Inspection (Housing Office resale certification)
resale_co.issued_by: Mount Holly Township Code Enforcement and Housing Department (Housing Office)
requirements: Heating system certification by an HVAC-R contractor or master plumber (form expires 1 year after the inspection date); the application asks for its date
Fire (smoke/CO) certification date is asked on the application
At least one working 10-year sealed battery smoke detector on each level including the basement; CO detectors within 10 feet of sleeping areas
Handrails on stairs with 4 or more risers; guard rails on porches/decks 30 inches or more above grade
GFCI within 6 feet of water sources; circuit breaker panel in order; no bare-wire fixtures
Ceilings, walls and floors with no holes, chipped paint, severe cracks or water stains; no ripped or old carpet
Interior doors sound, fit the frame and close properly; no keyed locks or deadbolts on interior doors
Heat working; appliances working with anti-tip bracket on the range
Hot and cold water; toilets flush
Bathroom has a window or exhaust fan
Utilities on at the time of inspection
Yard free of trash, debris and motor vehicles; all code violations fixed
Roof, chimney, siding, gutters and downspouts intact; windows and screens work
Driveway, sidewalks and aprons in safe condition; no trip hazards
No work done without permits

fees.label: 3rd or more inspection, per unit (2016 fee sheet)

resale_co.how_to_apply: Fill out the Resale Inspection Application (all fields required, including settlement date, heater certification date and fire certification date) and submit it to the Township Housing Office, 17 Pine Street, Mount Holly, NJ 08060. The form lists payment by check, money order, cash or credit card. Call 609-864-1203 or 609-864-2464 with questions.

evidence.quote: Resale and Rental Inspections : Conducts mandatory health and safety property checks required for residential resales and tenancy turnovers.
Housing Office 17 Pine Street, Mount Holly, NJ 08060 609-864-1203 or 609-864-2464 RESALE INSPECTION APPLICATION (Form must be completely filled out/All information must be supplied)
Below is a guideline list that the Code Enforcement Office uses when doing your sale of property or rental inspection.
FEES FOR HOUSING INSPECTIONS EFFECTIVE MAY 5, 2016

resale_co.notes: The Township says resale inspections are mandatory, and the Resale Inspection Application is labeled 2026. The only fee sheet online is dated effective May 5, 2016 ($150.00 resale inspection), so confirm the current fee. The fee sheet also lists 'Rental lnspection/2 Year Inspection $150.00/unit' (rental program). Housing staff listed: Carolyn Youngbean and Lee Eckert (leckert@twp.mountholly.nj.us), Monday to Thursday. The department page also says the Housing Department issues a Certificate of Continued Occupancy (CCO) and handles 'Trash and Escrow Verifications' with real estate agents and escrow officers. How far ahead to apply and how long the certificate lasts are not published. Township code (ecode360 MO1235) was not read. The old www.mountholly.nj.us host did not connect; the new site is twp.mountholly.nj.us (launched June 2026).

requirements: Smoke and CO detectors must be 10-year sealed battery (lithium) or hardwired, no more than 10 years old, and UL listed; at least one on each level including the basement
Hardwired smoke/CO detectors may not be replaced with battery units
Basement detector on the ceiling at the bottom of the basement stairs
CO alarm within 10 feet of every bedroom

Portable fire extinguisher: new within 12 months with receipt, or serviced by a NJ-certified extinguisher contractor; at least 2A-10:BC and not over 10 pounds; mounted on the manufacturer's bracket within 10 feet of the kitchen in the exit path; top no more than 5 feet and bottom at least 4.5 inches above the floor; not hidden in a cabinet or behind a door (per the district page last updated January 2024)
House numbers at least 4 inches high, contrasting color, permanently affixed, visible from the street
Monitored central alarm systems need an NFPA 72 inspection report from a NJ-licensed fire protection company at or before the inspection

authorities.name: Mount Holly Fire District No. 1, Bureau of Fire Prevention
authorities.lead_time: Within 60 days of settlement, the seller contacts the Township Bureau of Housing and Code Enforcement to schedule the resale inspection.

fees.label: Resale fire inspection, per dwelling unit
fees.quote: The inspection fee of $85.00 per dwelling unit fee shall be presented to the inspector in the form of certified check, money order, or business check (cash and personal checks will not be accepted as payment) .

fees.label: Apartment house common area (in addition to $85.00 per apartment)
fees.quote: Apartment houses are charged an inspection fee of $85.00 per apartment as well as $85.00 for the common area (basement, hallway access, lobby, etc.).

fees.label: Reinspection after noncompliance, per occurrence
fees.quote: A determination of noncompliance requiring reinspection will be charged $50 per occurrence until compliance.

authorities.how_to_apply: Call (609) 864-2451 or email the Township Bureau of Housing and Code Enforcement to schedule, giving the property address and settlement date (the district page lists kscelba@twp.mountholly.nj.us, which may be out of date; the district's current contact page lists Smoke Detector Certifications at (609) 864-2464). Pay the inspector with a certified check, money order or business check made payable to MOUNT HOLLY FIRE DISTRICT No.1. Cash and personal checks are not accepted. If the home is not accessible or fails, reschedule and pay again.

fire_cert.notes: Mount Holly Fire District No. 1 is the fire code enforcing agency (DCA LEA registry, July 2026). The district's resale page (first posted May 13, 2020, last modified January 13, 2024 per the site's WordPress data) says the Township Bureau of Housing and Code Enforcement schedules the resale inspections and the fire fee is paid to the Fire District. The Smoke Detector Certifications number on the district site ((609) 864-2464) is the same number as the Township Housing Office, so the smoke/CO certificate appears to be scheduled through the Housing Office along with the Township resale inspection. The page still lists a portable fire extinguisher requirement; it was last updated before the February 2025 state law (P.L.2025, c.19) that removed the extinguisher from the state requirement, so ask whether it is still enforced. The district's Bureau of Fire Prevention page showed a bot check to curl and was not read. The state directory lists the Fire Official's phone as (609) 261-7233; the district's own site lists (609) 518-8911 (used here).

other_items.label: Heating system certification
other_items.detail: A licensed HVAC-R contractor or master plumber must fill out the Township Heating System Certification; it expires one year from the inspection date.

other_items.label: Trash and recycling escrow
other_items.detail: The Housing Office verifies trash compliance and recycling carts at closing; the 2016 fee sheet lists a $250.00 trash escrow and $100.00 recycling cart escrow.

other_items.label: Work without permits
other_items.detail: The inspection checklist includes 'Work without Permits'. Construction Office: inspections@twp.mountholly.nj.us.
